admin.models_desc: Enable, disable and unload code-analysis models
admin.models_subtitle: Enable models and unload them from memory. Changes take effect immediately and survive restarts.

models.unload_hint: Free memory without disabling the model. It reloads on the next request.
models.reload_hint: Re-read settings and warm up enabled models. Needed after unloading.
models.overridden_hint: The administrator's decision differs from the value in .env
models.blocked: Will not run while “{{name}}” is disabled
models.load_failed: Could not load the model list
models.note: Disabling a model frees memory only after unloading: “Load” warms up what is enabled but not disabled. A disabled model is not loaded on demand — the application will report it as unavailable.
models.encoder_purpose: Turns commit messages and task texts into vectors, which the model uses to match commits to tasks. The heaviest part: roughly a gigabyte of weights held in memory.
models.type_classifier_purpose: Determines the commit type from the meaning of the changes: fix, feature, refactoring and others. Runs on the encoder's vectors, so it cannot be enabled without it.
models.progress_estimator_purpose: Computes task progress from changed lines, subtasks and files named in the description. No neural network is used — these are rules, and they take no memory.

admin.storage_subtitle: Settings apply immediately: file uploads and trash cleanup read them on every request.

storage.max_file_size_hint: Larger files are rejected on upload
storage.default_project_limit_hint: Applies to projects without their own limit
storage.extensions_hint: Comma separated. The dot is added automatically, duplicates removed.
storage.retention_hint: How many days before deletion becomes permanent
storage.retention_explain: The trash holds {{expired}} records past the retention period — they disappear at the next automatic cleanup.
storage.note: Deleting a file frees room in the project quota but not the file itself: it disappears when the trash is cleaned. “Purge expired” touches only what is past the retention period and leaves fresh deletions in place.
